authorship: Project-authored teaching basis; not an upstream copy or validated disease preset
timing: Smooth onset over final quarter of QRS; J at QRS end; endpoint at T onset; decay to zero at T end
limitations: The additive offset changes terminal QRS and the baseline under T. It does not independently preserve T height above the isoelectric line. No ischemic territory, reciprocal lead or normality inference.
arch: Optional signed 16*x^2*(1-x)^2 basis on ST only, normalized phase x in [0,1]. Zero value and slope at both ends; unit midpoint. Project-authored contour, not a disease preset.
